name: Model CR-28 flame cannon
description: The model CR-28 flame cannon manufactured by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc. was a larger version of the regular flamethrower with a longer range, hotter temperature, and greater fuel capacity.

data.name: Model CR-28 flame cannon
data.cost: 2,500 to 3,000 credits (Available for military use only)
size: Too large to use as personal weapon
Must be mounted on vehicle or tripod
capacity: Shoots a large cone of fire 18 meters long and 12 meters wide at the terminus
